text.p: RZECZPOSPOLITA

- The EU Chambers of Commerce Forum will concentrate on problems related to Poland's unfair competition and banking in 1997, the organisation president Jan Kluk said. The Forum acts as a lobbying and consulting body of the EU-based businesses operating in Poland.

- Poland's public sector employees whose salaries did not exceed inflation by more than 5.5 percentage points will receive a one-off bonus of 97.8 zlotys, the cabinet's social and political council said.
- Atu Life and Hestia Life insurance firms, both with German shareholders, have received operating licences in Poland, the companies said.
- Around 87.5 million foreigners visited Poland last year, which showed a six percent growth compared with 1995.

- The listed Animex food producer and trader is ready to acquire controlling stakes in the Szczecin-based ZM Agryf meat processing plant and the Elk-based ZM Mazury meat processor in its plan to win a 15 percent share in Poland's poultry and red meat market, Animex said.
- The Kolobrzeg-based SP Baltyk fish processing firm is planning to increase output by 30 percent and double exports this year, Baltyk president Tomasz Rewinski said.
- Gdansk port and the ZA Pulawy fertiliser plant will build a fertiliser reloading facility in the port worth 40 million zlotys, ZA Pulawy said.
NOWA EUROPA
- The listed Stalexport steel producer and trader has won a licence to operate a 61 km stretch of the A-4 toll motorway from Katowice to Krakow, Motorway Construction Agency said.

- Agco Corporation is planning to buy a strategic 40 percent stake in the Warsaw-based ZPC Ursus tractor maker, industry sources said. Arkadiusz Krezel, the head of the Industrial Development Agency (ARP), which controls Ursus, denied having signed a letter of intent with Agco.
- Almost 87 percent of all credits awarded by the BOS environmental protection bank to institutions in northeastern Poland last year were related to environment protection projects, BOS said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
- Poland's tobacco makers have increased cigarette prices by up to 0.05 zloty a pack, which was related to the expected excise tax increase in February this year, cigarette wholesalers said.

- The Lubelski Bank Depozytowo Kredytowy (LBDK) bank decided to rise interest rates before the central bank announcement of the obligatory reserves' increase. Interests on LBDK consumer credits rose from 24.5 to 25.5 percent, the bank said.
ZYCIE
- Warsaw-based subscribers of the Centertel analogue telephone firm have recently experienced connection problems.
Current malfunctions may be caused by the excessive number of subscribers calling in the area of Warsaw, Centerel's spokesman Jacek Kalinowski said.
PARKIET

- Over 30 Polish-based brokerage houses have passed the professional and ethical brokerage code, which specified the role of a broker in a financial institution, brokerage houses' chamber president Krzysztof Wantola said.
